page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.sn2.xlarge sits primarily in the lower tiers for compute and memory operations. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests yield weak results, which is mirrored by a Geekbench single-core score of 848.0 and a multi-core score of 3291.0. Memory bandwidth tests show weak read performance at 37.94 GB/sec for large blocks, though write performance for large blocks reaches an average tier at 33.29 GB/sec. The instance also demonstrates average performance in Passmark CPU tests and small-model LLM inference, while database operations and Redis SET operations remain weak.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2.xlarge offers a dedicated hardware profile with a standard resource density, though its older processor architecture results in lower performance per resource compared to newer generations. Because it lacks local storage and exhibits weak database and web serving throughput, this instance is best suited for general-purpose workloads with moderate CPU demands, such as basic application hosting, development environments, and light background processing tasks that do not require high-speed local disk access or intensive memory bandwidth.
